paper_title: First Constraints on the Photon Coupling of Axion-like Particles from Multimessenger Studies of the Neutron Star Merger GW170817
notes: Paper derives first ALP-photon coupling constraints from GW170817 NS merger using Fermi-LAT. Coupling type (AxionPhoton, g_agamma in GeV^-1) is unambiguous. However, exact exclusion contour points are not given in tables; only two benchmark points are explicitly stated (Benchmark 1: ma=398 MeV=3.98e8 eV, g=5.01e-11 GeV^-1; Benchmark 2: ma=200 MeV=2e8 eV, g=1.41e-12 GeV^-1) which are INSIDE the excluded region. The exclusion region spans roughly ma ~ 100 MeV to ~1 GeV down to g~1e-12 GeV^-1. Data points listed are approximate reconstructions of the exclusion boundary from text/figure and should be treated as rough. This is an astrophysical (stellar/merger) bound, not a DM haloscope, so no DM density assumed. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 3, 0, 0.5, 8)) | read-vote N=3: ct=AxionPhoton (3/3); medoid 1 of 3 curves (med pairwise 0.394 dex)
